description: Join the waitlist for Himalayas Radar, a planned plan for people who are employed or not actively searching: alerts only for roles that beat their bar, a private open-to-offers mode with their current employer hidden, and a monthly salary check. Radar isn't available yet, so there is nothing to pay; Himalayas emails the user when it launches. Call it only if the user wants to join. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.
